parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is offering 2 Sheep for 1 Brick. Currently, I have 2 Bricks, 2 Wood, 2 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I need 1 of each to build a settlement at node 50 (where I already have a road). If I accept the trade, I'll have 1 Brick, 2 Wood, 2 Wheat, and 3 Sheep. I will still have exactly what I need to build the settlement on my turn. Since I have no sheep production on the board, getting two sheep for one brick is an excellent value deal (2:1). Additionally, it helps rebuild trust with Hadar after our history. The only risk is that I'll have 8 cards in hand, making me vulnerable to a 7 roll on Ziv's turn, but the benefit of securing the sheep outweighs this risk.
